title: China-to-Japan Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Japan's DENAN (Electrical Appliances and Materials Safety Act) governs electrical product safety. In-scope corded power tools and AC chargers/adaptors that connect to the 100/200 V 50/60 Hz mains may fall under DENAN as either Specified or Non-specified Electrical Appliances, requiring the matching diamond or round PSE mark. Conformity is demonstrated against the DENAN technical standards, with JIS C 62841 (= IEC 62841) and JIS C 9745 commonly used for power-tool electrical safety. A Japan-resident business notifier (事業届出) must be in place.
target_standards: Electrical Appliances and Materials Safety Act (電気用品安全法, DENAN), PSE mark
DENAN technical standards (Ministerial Ordinance) for in-scope appliances
JIS C 62841 (= IEC 62841) for hand-held/transportable power tool electrical safety [voluntary technical route]
JIS C 9745 power-tool safety series [voluntary technical route]
Japan-resident business notification (事業届出)
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools and separate charger standards where applicable, with CCC where the product is in the compulsory catalogue. GB 3883 evidence is built around China's 220/380 V 50 Hz grid and does not automatically satisfy DENAN technical standards or the PSE conformity route.
china_standards: China CCC where the product is in the compulsory catalogue
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is presenting GB 3883 or generic CE reports as PSE evidence and overlooking Japan's 100/200 V 50/60 Hz design, the Specified vs Non-specified PSE classification, the correct PSE mark, and the Japan-resident business notifier. Plug type, dual-frequency operation, and DENAN technical-standard mapping must be addressed for the marketed tool and its charger/adaptor.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for in-scope corded tools and AC chargers/adaptors: DENAN (電気用品安全法) with the matching PSE mark and a Japan-resident business notifier. JIS C 62841 and JIS C 9745 are voluntary technical routes, not standalone mandatory acts.
target.zh: 适用有线工具和交流充电器/适配器的强制法律义务：DENAN（电气用品安全法），附相应 PSE 标志及日本境内事业届出主体。JIS C 62841 和 JIS C 9745 为自愿技术路径，并非独立强制法律文件。
target.zht: 適用有線工具和交流充電器/適配器的強制法律義務：DENAN（電氣用品安全法），附相應 PSE 標誌及日本境內事業屆出主體。JIS C 62841 和 JIS C 9745 為自願技術路徑，並非獨立強制法律文件。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB 3883 series, with CCC where the product is in the compulsory catalogue.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB 3883 系列，列入强制目录的产品需 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB 3883 系列，列入強制目錄的產品需 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until the Japan file maps the corded tool and its charger/adaptor to the correct DENAN PSE classification and mark, demonstrates the DENAN technical standards (with JIS C 62841/C 9745 as supporting evidence), addresses 100/200 V 50/60 Hz design, and names a Japan-resident business notifier.

source.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan

rows.target_requirement: Japan addresses electromagnetic disturbance from electrical products mainly through the VCCI Council framework for information-technology and many electronic apparatus, with motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies assessed for emission limits. VCCI registration and marking is a self-regulatory voluntary scheme based on CISPR-aligned JIS limits; products with radio functions also fall under separate MIC radio rules. The product must not generate excessive electromagnetic disturbance on the 100/200 V 50/60 Hz grid.
target_standards: VCCI Council technical requirements (CISPR-aligned JIS emission limits) [self-regulatory voluntary scheme]
MIC radio regulation / Giteki (技適) for any radio function
Relevant JIS C / CISPR EMC measurement standards [voluntary technical route]
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB 3883 safety reports, with CCC EMC requirements where in scope. China test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and the marking scheme differ from the VCCI framework and still need Japan-specific review.
china_standards: China CCC EMC requirements where applicable
China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent Japan gap is an EMC report tested only on the bare tool or to non-Japan limits, omitting the charger, battery pack, electronic controller variants, or worst-case load conditions, and not mapped to VCCI marking. Tools with any wireless feature also need MIC Giteki, which a China EMC report does not cover.

target.en: VCCI is a self-regulatory voluntary scheme rather than a single statutory EMC act for tools; however, any radio function triggers a mandatory legal obligation under MIC radio law (Giteki). Emission performance is expected by the market and major channels even where the VCCI mark itself is voluntary.
target.zh: VCCI 是自律自愿方案，而非针对工具的单一法定电磁兼容法律；但任何无线功能都会触发 MIC 无线法（技适）下的强制法律义务。即便 VCCI 标志本身为自愿，市场和主要渠道也普遍要求达到发射性能。
target.zht: VCCI 是自律自願方案，而非針對工具的單一法定電磁相容法律；但任何無線功能都會觸發 MIC 無線法（技適）下的強制法律義務。即便 VCCI 標誌本身為自願，市場和主要通路也普遍要求達到發射性能。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence (CCC EMC where in scope), but Japan acceptance depends on limits, configuration, and VCCI/Giteki mapping.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据（适用时含 CCC 电磁兼容），但日本接受性取决于限值、配置及 VCCI/技适映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據（適用時含 CCC 電磁相容），但日本接受性取決於限值、配置及 VCCI/技適映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Japan-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system to VCCI-applicable JIS/CISPR limits, and any wireless function is separately certified under MIC Giteki. A China EMC or CCC report cannot substitute for VCCI marking or Giteki certification.

source.publisher: VCCI Council (Voluntary Control Council for Interference), Japan

rows.requirement: Market Access Under Japan's DENAN Regime
rows.target_requirement: Placing electric or cordless power tools on the Japanese market is governed by DENAN (電気用品安全法) administered by METI. A Japan-resident business operator must file the manufacturing or import notification (事業届出), maintain conformity to the DENAN technical standards, affix the correct PSE mark, keep records, and for Specified Electrical Appliances obtain conformity assessment from a registered conformity-assessment body. Goods clear via ports such as Tokyo/Yokohama and Kobe. JIS standards such as JIS C 62841 support but do not replace the legal notification and PSE duties.
target_standards: Electrical Appliances and Materials Safety Act (電気用品安全法, DENAN), administered by METI
Business notification (事業届出) by a Japan-resident operator
PSE mark (diamond for Specified, round for Non-specified Electrical Appliances)
Conformity assessment by a registered conformity-assessment body for Specified Electrical Appliances
JIS C 62841 series [voluntary technical route]
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool placement relies on the GB 3883 series and, where the product is in the compulsory catalogue, CCC certification. GB 3883 and CCC evidence does not replace the Japanese DENAN business notification, PSE marking, technical-file maintenance, or registered conformity-assessment-body involvement.
china_standards: China CCC where the product is in the compulsory catalogue
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report or CCC certificate is not enough for Japanese placement. The importer needs a Japan-resident business notifier filing 事業届出, the correct PSE classification and mark, DENAN technical-standard conformity, retained records, and conformity-assessment-body evidence for Specified Electrical Appliances, mapped to the actual marketed model.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: DENAN (電気用品安全法) business notification, technical-standard conformity, and PSE marking, with registered conformity-assessment-body involvement for Specified Electrical Appliances. JIS C 62841 is voluntary and is not itself mandatory.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：DENAN（电气用品安全法）事业届出、技术标准符合性及 PSE 标识，特定电气用品须有登录合格评定机构参与。JIS C 62841 为自愿标准，本身不是强制要求。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：DENAN（電氣用品安全法）事業屆出、技術標準符合性及 PSE 標識，特定電氣用品須有登錄合格評定機構參與。JIS C 62841 為自願標準，本身不是強制要求。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB 3883 series, with CCC where the product is in the compulsory catalogue.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB 3883 系列，列入强制目录的产品需 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB 3883 系列，列入強制目錄的產品需 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Japan-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB 3883 or CCC evidence. A Japan-resident 事業届出, correct PSE classification and marking, DENAN technical-standard conformity, and conformity-assessment-body evidence for Specified appliances are required; JIS C 62841 can support the file but cannot be labelled mandatory.

source.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan

rows.requirement: Noise: No EU-Style Outdoor Product Marking in Japan
rows.target_requirement: Unlike the EU, Japan does not impose an EU-style mandatory outdoor-equipment noise-emission marking (there is no Japanese equivalent of Directive 2000/14/EC requiring a guaranteed sound-power level label on power tools). Noise in Japan is handled mainly as an environmental and occupational matter: the Noise Regulation Law governs construction-site and factory noise at the place of use, and the Industrial Safety and Health Act with related occupational-noise guidance addresses worker exposure. These are use-site and employer obligations, not a product label affixed by the manufacturer or importer. JIS sound-measurement methods may be cited voluntarily for declared noise data.
target_standards: Noise Regulation Law (騒音規制法) [environmental, use-site obligation, not a product mark]
Industrial Safety and Health Act (労働安全衛生法) and occupational-noise guidance [employer obligation]
JIS acoustic sound-power/measurement standards [voluntary technical route for declared data]
rows.china_equivalent: China GB 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and typically does not include a product noise label. China handles noise via workplace and environmental rules at the place of use rather than a mandatory product-affixed sound-power marking. This is structurally similar to Japan's use-site approach.
china_standards: China workplace and environmental noise rules where applicable (use-site, not a product mark)
rows.gap: There is effectively no product-marking gap to close for Japan on this point, because Japan has no EU-style outdoor product-noise label. Exporters should not assume an EU 2000/14/EC noise plate is required for Japan; instead, noise data is supplied voluntarily, and the operative Japanese obligations (Noise Regulation Law, occupational-noise) sit with the user/employer at the site of use. The real action is to avoid over-engineering an unnecessary Japan noise label and to keep any declared noise data measured by a recognized JIS method.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style product noise marking exists for power tools in Japan. Mandatory noise obligations are use-site/employer duties under the Noise Regulation Law and the Industrial Safety and Health Act, not a manufacturer/importer product label.
target.zh: 日本对电动工具不存在欧盟式强制产品噪声标识。强制噪声义务是噪声规制法和劳动安全卫生法下的使用地点/雇主义务，而非制造商/进口商的产品标识。
target.zht: 日本對電動工具不存在歐盟式強制產品噪聲標識。強制噪聲義務是噪聲規制法和勞動安全衛生法下的使用地點/雇主義務，而非製造商/進口商的產品標識。

cn.en: China likewise has no mandatory product-affixed sound-power label for power tools; noise is governed at the place of use.
cn.zh: 中国同样没有针对电动工具的强制产品声功率标识；噪声在使用地点层面管辖。
cn.zht: 中國同樣沒有針對電動工具的強制產品聲功率標識；噪聲在使用地點層面管轄。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style outdoor product-noise marking is required for Japan, so there is no product-label compliance step here; exporters should treat Japanese noise obligations as use-site and occupational duties and supply any declared noise data on a voluntary, JIS-measured basis rather than replicating an EU 2000/14/EC plate.

rows.target_requirement: Japan controls hazardous-substance disclosure for electrical and electronic equipment mainly through J-Moss (JIS C 0950), the marking for presence of the specified chemical substances. Designated product categories must display the J-Moss content mark (orange R for exceeding reference values, green for compliant) and provide content information. Scope and triggers differ from EU RoHS, so power tools, chargers, and electronic accessories need a Japan-specific J-Moss determination and supply-chain material evidence where the category is designated.
target_standards: J-Moss (JIS C 0950) marking for presence of the specified chemical substances
Act on the Promotion of Effective Utilization of Resources (資源有効利用促進法) framework for designated categories
Supply-chain homogeneous-material content evidence [technical documentation]
rows.china_equivalent: China uses China RoHS (Administrative Measure for the Restriction of Hazardous Substances in EEE) with marking and disclosure, alongside GB 3883 for safety. China RoHS and GB 3883 evidence can support material review, but it does not automatically satisfy Japan's J-Moss marking format, reference values, or designated-category scope.
china_standards: China RoHS marking and disclosure requirements where applicable
rows.gap: The Japan gap is usually material-traceability and marking-format evidence rather than tool performance: the file needs J-Moss category screening (JIS C 0950), the correct content mark (orange R or green), reference-value assessment of the six specified substances, and homogeneous-material declarations from suppliers. China RoHS labels and content tables must be remapped to the J-Moss format and Japan reference values.

target.en: Mandatory marking/disclosure obligation for designated product categories: J-Moss (JIS C 0950) under the Act on the Promotion of Effective Utilization of Resources. Where the category is not designated, the J-Moss mark itself is not required, but material evidence still supports product safety and customer assurance.
target.zh: 指定产品类别的强制标识/披露义务：资源有效利用促进法下的 J-Moss（JIS C 0950）。若类别未被指定，则 J-Moss 标识本身非必需，但材料证据仍支持产品安全和客户保证。
target.zht: 指定產品類別的強制標識/披露義務：資源有效利用促進法下的 J-Moss（JIS C 0950）。若類別未被指定，則 J-Moss 標識本身非必需，但材料證據仍支援產品安全和客戶保證。

cn.en: China RoHS marking or GB 3883 evidence does not automatically satisfy Japan's J-Moss documentation and marking format.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 标识或 GB 3883 证据不会自动满足日本 J-Moss 文件和标识格式要求。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 標識或 GB 3883 證據不會自動滿足日本 J-Moss 文件和標識格式要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Japan-ready until the substance file supports J-Moss (JIS C 0950) for designated categories with the correct content mark, reference-value assessment, and homogeneous-material evidence for the actual tool, charger, and accessories; China RoHS evidence must be remapped to the J-Moss format.

source.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan

rows.target_requirement: Lithium battery packs for cordless tools placed on the Japanese market are addressed through DENAN for in-scope lithium-ion batteries (DENAN added lithium-ion storage batteries as a regulated electrical appliance requiring the round PSE mark and conformity to the technical standard), plus JIS safety standards and transport rules for lithium cells. Charging via an AC charger/adaptor also engages the DENAN PSE obligations covered in the electrical fragment. Recycling/recovery of small rechargeable batteries is handled under Japan's resource-recycling framework rather than an EU-style battery passport.
target_standards: DENAN (電気用品安全法) for in-scope lithium-ion storage batteries, round PSE mark
JIS lithium-battery safety standards [voluntary technical route]
Act on the Promotion of Effective Utilization of Resources (資源有効利用促進法) for small rechargeable battery recycling
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB 3883, with separate GB lithium-battery safety standards and transport evidence, and CCC where applicable. Japan's DENAN PSE obligation attaches to the in-scope lithium battery itself, so the China battery evidence must be remapped to the DENAN technical standard and PSE marking.
china_standards: China GB lithium battery safety standards and transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: Cordless tools need battery-level Japan compliance in addition to tool-level safety. A battery pack that passes China domestic or transport tests may still need the DENAN round PSE mark and technical-standard conformity for the lithium battery, JIS-aligned safety evidence, and enrolment in Japan's small-rechargeable-battery recycling scheme, with the AC charger separately handled under DENAN.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for in-scope lithium-ion batteries: DENAN (電気用品安全法) round PSE mark and technical-standard conformity; recycling duties under the Act on the Promotion of Effective Utilization of Resources. JIS battery safety standards are voluntary technical routes. Japan has no EU-style battery passport requirement.
target.zh: 适用锂离子电池的强制法律义务：DENAN（电气用品安全法）圆形 PSE 标志和技术标准符合性；资源有效利用促进法下的回收义务。JIS 电池安全标准为自愿技术路径。日本没有欧盟式电池护照要求。
target.zht: 適用鋰離子電池的強制法律義務：DENAN（電氣用品安全法）圓形 PSE 標誌和技術標準符合性；資源有效利用促進法下的回收義務。JIS 電池安全標準為自願技術路徑。日本沒有歐盟式電池護照要求。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence does not automatically satisfy Japan's DENAN lithium-battery PSE and recycling duties.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据不会自动满足日本 DENAN 锂电池 PSE 及回收义务。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據不會自動滿足日本 DENAN 鋰電池 PSE 及回收義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Japan-ready for cordless tools until the lithium battery pack is assessed under DENAN (round PSE mark and technical standard) with JIS-aligned safety evidence and recycling-scheme enrolment, and the AC charger is separately handled under DENAN; an EU-style battery passport is not required for Japan.

source.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan
